injectedCondition: Redis becomes unavailable after Nova has committed the run and before the observer appends the attempt event.

firstFailedSignal.observation: Authenticated PING, bounded XADD, or the owning adapter command returns a classified connection, authentication, timeout, protocol, or no-eviction capacity error.
notProof: Absence of a stream entry does not prove that Nova did not commit the lifecycle event.
A later Redis readiness success does not prove that the missing projection was replayed.

authorityAfterFailure.owner: Nova event journal and run state

authorityAfterFailure.data: Buster job, node result, and evidence
Prism project, design request, agent job, revision, and approval

authorityAfterFailure.owner: OCI manifest digest and Buster receipt
Tailscale lease generation and fixture receipt

safeStopRule: Stop only the adapter, observer, or consumer whose contract requires Redis. Do not change a committed Nova or Buster result and do not create a replacement lifecycle event.
recoveryOwner: The Redis platform operator restores the selected Redis authority. The owning adapter or observer then reconciles from its documented source and original identity.
orderedRecovery: Retain the Nova and Buster owner records, the exact Redis error, and the original event or delivery identity.
Classify DNS, network, authentication, timeout, protocol, memory, and storage separately.
Restore the same Redis endpoint and credential source. Do not point one run at a new unverified authority.
Prove authenticated PING and the adapter's bounded write behavior.
Replay only when the adapter contract has a durable source and permits replay. Reuse the original idempotency or delivery key.
Verify the returned stream entry and deduplication result. Record an unrecoverable projection gap when no durable replay source exists.
Resume only the stopped consumer. Confirm that Nova and Buster owner records did not change during transport recovery.
boundedRetryRule: Retry only under the owning adapter deadline and deduplication window. Stop on authentication, protocol, no-eviction capacity, or repeated timeout failure. The OpenClaw agent-observability payload path has one write attempt and no replay source; its control path has three bounded attempts and one best-effort dead-letter write.
completionCondition: Redis accepts the bounded check and any permitted replay under the original identity, or the operator records the projection as unrecoverable. Nova and Buster authority records remain unchanged.
